messages.text: Read the nexus qx1 8th s page

Ran these for (address hidden), Germany, the address on your orders, at Germany's ~17 cents a kWh. Tell me your real rate and I'll redo it.

NEXUS QX1, $248, 8.1 TH/s at ~170 W (21 J/TH): stacks roughly 11,600 sats a month, about $9.70 at today's BTC price of $83k. Power runs about $21 a month. So at 17 cents it doesn't pay for its electricity; break-even sits around $180k BTC. Solo-block odds are long, roughly 1 in 800,000 a day, but a block is $261k.

Your Magic Miner 40T, already on order and shipping November 14, does 57,500 sats a month ($47.73) for $80.62 of power, break-even $140k. Better per TH than the QX1 by a wide margin.

Honest read: at German rates none of these turn a profit today, they stack sats and buy lottery tickets. The Q.1's real selling point is 170 W and under 50 dB, a quiet unit you can leave in a living room. If that's what you're after, it's a good one. If you want hashrate per euro, you already bought the better machine.

Today's estimate, price and difficulty move. Also, the $248 excludes 21% import VAT, which customs charges on delivery.
